prompts.title: 使用闪光灯拍摄的超逼真夜间汽车肖像
prompts.description: 一个高度详细的提示，包括负面提示，用于生成一张超现实、高对比度的女性肖像，她坐在豪华轿车后座，在夜晚，使用机顶闪光灯直射，并保留参考图像中精确的身体比例。
prompts.content:
Ultra-realistic flash photography of the subject from the reference image sitting in the backseat of a luxury car at night.

She is reclining naturally across a black leather seat, holding a smartphone casually in one hand.

Wardrobe:
Black lace-trim camisole (non-sheer, modest coverage)
Dark tailored shorts
Layered gold necklaces
Gold bracelets
Subtle ankle jewelry

Body proportions must remain EXACTLY as in the reference image.
No reshaping, no waist cinching, no curve exaggeration.

Car interior:
Dark leather upholstery
Wood trim panels
Subtle reflections on window glass
Night city reflections visible outside

Lighting:
Direct on-camera flash
Sharp highlights
Natural skin texture
High contrast
Glossy but realistic skin response to flash
No studio diffusion

Style:
Cinematic nightlife aesthetic
Editorial fashion photography
35mm lens look
Shallow depth of field
High detail
Luxury atmosphere

--------------------------------------

SETTINGS:
Resolution: 1024x1792
Lighting: Direct flash + nighttime ambient background
Camera: 35mm equivalent, f1.8, ISO 800
Quality: High detail, photorealistic

--------------------------------------

body reshaping, waist cinching, exaggerated curves,
face alteration, hair recolor,
ethnicity change, age shift,
plastic skin, glam filter,
blurry, low resolution,
overexposed highlights,
distorted anatomy,
extra limbs,
poorly drawn hands,
oversaturated colors,
cartoon, illustration, CGI,
watermark, text, logo
prompts.translatedContent:
参照图中人物坐在豪华轿车后座，在夜晚环境下，使用超写实闪光摄影。

她慵懒地斜倚在黑色皮质座椅上，一只手随意地拿着智能手机。

服饰：
黑色蕾丝边吊带背心（不透视，适度遮盖）
深色定制短裤
叠戴金色项链
金色手链
精致的脚踝饰品

身体比例必须与参照图**完全一致**。
不可重塑身形，不可收紧腰部，不可夸大曲线。

汽车内饰：
深色皮革内饰
木纹饰板
车窗玻璃上细微的反光
窗外可见夜间城市倒影

灯光：
直射机内闪光灯
锐利的高光
自然的皮肤纹理
高对比度
皮肤对闪光的反应光泽但真实
无影棚柔光

风格：
电影般的夜生活美学
时尚杂志摄影
35mm 镜头效果
浅景深
高细节
奢华氛围

--------------------------------------

设置：
分辨率：1024x1792
灯光：直射闪光灯 + 夜晚环境背景光
相机：35mm 等效焦距，f1.8，ISO 800
质量：高细节，照片级真实感

--------------------------------------

负面提示词：
身体重塑，收腰，夸张曲线，
面部改动，头发改色，
改变种族，年龄变化，
塑料皮肤，美颜滤镜，
模糊，低分辨率，
高光过曝，
解剖结构扭曲，
多余肢体，
手部绘制拙劣，
颜色过饱和，
卡通，插画，CGI，
水印，文字，标志

prompts.title: 动态 3D 浮动头像
prompts.description: 一个高度具体的提示，用于根据参考图像生成一个超风格化、动态的 3D 浮动头像肖像，特点是自信的表情、镶钻牙套、银色运动太阳镜和官方湖人队球衣标志，背景为带有霓虹灯点缀和强烈边缘照明的纯白色。
prompts.content:
Hyper-stylized dynamic 3D floating head portrait of the attached reference image, perfectly centered, upright, symmetrical, filling 80% of the 4:5 frame. No neck. No shoulder edges. Clean cut-out. Subject floating in white space.Predominantly white background enhanced with subtle tonal gradients and soft volumetric glow. A thin luminous neon halo ring glows behind the head, slightly diffused but clean and circular.

Facial features match reference photo precisely. Expression: confident, dominant smirk with focused eye contact. Diamond-studded braces sparkle under sharp lighting.

Sleek silver sports sunglasses reflect digital stadium lights and neon streaks. Chrome stud earrings and polished silver chain subtly visible.

Official lakers shirt strictly front view chest logo and sponsor visible only.

Lighting combines bright frontal fill with strong rim lights. Subtle neon reflections trace along jawline edges. Micro lens flares appear at high-intensity highlights.

White-on-white energy with controlled neon accents. Futuristic champion aura. Glossy skin, exaggerated reflections, cinematic intensity.

Aspect ratio 4:5.
prompts.translatedContent:
超风格化的动态 3D 浮动头像，基于所附参考图像，完美居中，直立，对称，占据 4:5 画面 80% 的空间。无颈部。无肩部边缘。干净的抠图。主体悬浮在白色空间中。以微妙的色调渐变和柔和的体积光增强的纯白色背景。头部后方有一个纤细的发光霓虹光环，略微扩散但清晰且呈圆形。

面部特征与参考照片精确匹配。表情：自信、主导的坏笑，眼神专注。镶钻牙套在锐利灯光下闪闪发光。

光滑的银色运动太阳镜反射着数字体育场灯光和霓虹条纹。镀铬耳钉和抛光银链隐约可见。

官方湖人队球衣，仅正面胸部标志和赞助商可见。

灯光结合了明亮的前部补光和强烈的轮廓光。微妙的霓虹反射沿着下颌线边缘勾勒。高强度高光处出现微小的镜头眩光。

白色与白色的能量，辅以受控的霓虹点缀。未来冠军的光环。光泽肌肤，夸张反射，电影般的强度。

长宽比 4:5。
